title: Data Analyst- Italy
description:
In ProMach cerchiamo persone pronte a mettere in risalto il proprio talento.
Qui hai occasione di sviluppare la tua carriera, condividere idee ambiziose e avere un impatto concreto.
Ti abbiamo incuriosito? Continua a leggere.
Job Summary
ProMach is seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative Data Analyst to help transform our complex data landscape into actionable business insights. You’ll work with data from multiple ERP, CRM, and operational systems, supporting key business decisions in finance, operations, and supply chain. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on data work, cross-functional collaboration, and building impactful reports and dashboards. Fluency in Italian and English required
Why This Role Matters
As a Data Analyst at ProMach, you’ll play a critical role in shaping business strategy by collecting, analyzing, and visualizing data from dozens of systems and databases. Your insights will help drive efficiency, identify opportunities, and support growth across the organization.
Key Responsibilities
- Collect, clean, and analyze data from ERP, CRM, and other business systems to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
- Develop and maintain dashboards, KPIs, and reports for business users and leadership.
- Write SQL queries and use analytics tools to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
- Collaborate with stakeholders across departments to understand business needs and translate them into data requirements.
- Present findings and recommendations through clear visualizations and presentations.
- Support data migration, integration, and quality initiatives to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
- Document data processes, definitions, and methodologies for transparency and repeatability.
- Stay current with best practices in data analysis, visualization, and reporting.
Qualifications
Required:
- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative or analytical area, or demonstrated equivalent experience in data analysis or a related field
- 2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
- Proficiency in SQL and experience with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
- Experience building dashboards and reports using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and data kccuracy.
- Ability to communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Experience gathering requirements and working with cross-functional teams.
- Deep Knowledge of data flows within ERP/CRM systems (e.g., SAP, Infor LN, Salesforce) in a manufacturing environment
- Candidate must be fluent in both Italian and English.
Preferred
- Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Delta Lake).
- Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and metadata documentation.
- Experience with Python or R for data analysis is a plus.
- Exposure to Agile project environments and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Git).
Cosa significa per te?
Con noi non ci sono vincoli sulle idee innovative né limiti per la tua crescita professionale. Offriamo un ambiente aperto e comunicativo che valorizza l’iniziativa personale. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un’azienda in cui le persone si trovano a proprio agio e scelgono di costruire la propria carriera.
Oltre alle opportunità di sviluppo, come dipendente ProMach riceverai molto più del tuo compenso. Il pacchetto retributivo include la tua retribuzione, programmi di assistenza medica, un generoso programma di ferie retribuite e la possibilità di aderire a un piano di risparmio pensionistico con contributo aziendale. E poiché sappiamo quanto sia importante sentirsi tutelati, i benefici sono attivi fin dal primo giorno di lavoro: nessun periodo di attesa.
Pro Mach, Inc. è stata inserita sette volte nella lista Inc. 5000 delle aziende private a più rapida crescita negli Stati Uniti.
Continuiamo a introdurre prodotti innovativi, entrare in nuovi mercati, espandere la nostra presenza globale e acquisire nuove competenze.
Offriamo le ricompense, le opportunità e la forza di mercato di una grande organizzazione, unite alla cultura imprenditoriale di un’azienda piccola e dinamica. Potrai godere dei vantaggi di lavorare in un’azienda in crescita che compete a livello globale, con il tocco personale e l’atmosfera di una piccola azienda dove puoi fare la differenza ogni giorno.
ProMach è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità. Tutte le candidature saranno valutate senza distinzione di origine, sesso, età, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, religione o qualsiasi altra caratteristica tutelata dalla legge.
In conformità alla normativa italiana, ProMach si impegna a garantire le pari opportunità e a favorire l’inserimento e l’integrazione lavorativa delle persone con disabilità. Possono essere previsti adeguati accomodamenti per consentire la piena partecipazione al processo di selezione e lo svolgimento delle mansioni previste. I candidati che necessitano di un accomodamento sono invitati a contattarci.

title: Data Analyst (Italy) B2B
description:
Adastra is a global IT company, offering premier class services and solutions in the area of Information Management. We work in international teams and on projects for leading global financial, automotive, telecommunications and insurance pioneers. We pride ourselves in accepting the challenge of mastering new technologies with each new task and in empowering our clients in achieving results. What gives us satisfaction is the opportunity to apply innovation in our jobs daily, inclusive of new areas such as Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, Internet of Things, Blockchain, Cloud, Data Monetization and Robotic Process Automation.
Please note: This position is open to candidates who are currently based in Italy and have the legal right to work in the country. At this time, we are unable to offer relocation support.
We are looking for a Data Analyst to work closely with clients and internal teams to understand business needs, analyze data, define data mappings, and ensure the accuracy and quality of data within the Data Warehouse environment.
Responsibilities:
- Lead discussions with clients to understand their goals and translate them into data requirements.
- Analyze business requirements and define data mapping from source systems to the Data Warehouse (DWH).
- Present data analysis insights and explain complex data structures to clients in a clear and understandable way.
- Perform data profiling, exploratory analysis, and data validation to ensure data correctness.
- Define and maintain business logic, KPIs, and data definitions.
- Investigate data anomalies and collaborate with Data Engineers on issue resolution.
- Serve as the primary point of contact between clients and the technical DWH team.
- Mentor other team members and ensure high standards of data analysis and data mapping.
- Proactively propose data-driven solutions and improvements to clients' business processes.
Required Skills & Experience:
- 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, DWH Analyst, or similar role.
- Proven experience leading client discussions and translating business goals into data requirements.
- Strong experience in business requirements analysis and data mapping from source systems to Data Warehouses.
- Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) and T-SQL.
- Experience performing data profiling, exploratory analysis, and data validation to ensure data correctness.
- Experience defining and maintaining business logic, KPIs, and data definitions.
- Ability to investigate data anomalies and work closely with Data Engineers to resolve data issues.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex data structures to both business and technical audiences.
- Experience serving as the key point of contact between business stakeholders and technical teams.
- Experience mentoring team members and promoting best practices in data analysis and data mapping.
- Proactive, analytical, and solution-oriented mindset.
- Fluent Italian language skills are required.
- Based in Italy, preferably in the Bologna area, or willing to travel to Bologna occasionally.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Job Description:
Collect, process, and analyze data to provide actionable insights that support business decisions.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools to track key performance indicators (KPIs).
Work closely with cross-functional teams to identify data trends, patterns, and opportunities for process improvement.
Clean, validate, and interpret large datasets from multiple sources to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Assist in developing predictive models and automation tools to enhance data-driven decision-making.
Present findings and recommendations to management and stakeholders in a clear, concise manner.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field.
Proven experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or similar analytical roles.
Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Knowledge of Python or R for data processing and statistical analysis is an advantage.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to work independently and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
Benefits:
Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses.
Opportunities for professional growth and advanced data training.
Collaborative and innovative work culture.
Flexible or hybrid working arrangements.

title: Data Analyst - Field Marketing
Content Analyst
description:
About Us
Our vision is to change the way people search for property and make their lives easier with the use of technology. We've been pursuing this since 2006, and today we have 4 major portals in Greece and Cyprus and 10 more in Croatia, Serbia, Bosnia & Herzegovina, Montenegro, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Albania and Malta, with millions of visitors each month, disruptive technology and significant added value generated daily. Still, this is just the beginning; our industry is changing fast and, being a leading international service provider, we want to keep driving the change in such a significant life decision for every person, in a significant sector of the economy.
About You
We are looking for a dynamic Content Analyst who will sit at the intersection of content creation, data storytelling, and public relations. This person will craft impactful narratives based on data, engage with media and journalists, and contribute to Spitogatos’ thought leadership in the real estate industry.
Responsibilities:
Content Development
- Write and edit content for data reports, press releases, and blog articles.
- Translate data into clear, engaging stories for different audiences.
Public Relations & Media Outreach
- Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists and media outlets.
- Proactively pitch stories and ensure coverage of Spitogatos reports and insights.
Data & Analysis
- Cross-check data and collaborate with data team to ensure accuracy.
- Use Excel (and other tools) to perform basic data analysis that supports content development.
Collaboration
- Work closely with the Digital Marketing & Communications Manager on campaigns and strategy.
- Partner with the copywriter to align tone of voice and messaging across all content.
- Coordinate with the broader marketing team to amplify PR and content efforts.
Requirements:
- Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or a related field.
- Proven experience in content writing, PR, or journalism (experience with data-driven content is a plus).
- Strong writing and editing skills in Greek and English.
- Familiarity with Excel and comfort working with data.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, especially with media contacts.
- Ability to manage multiple projects with attention to detail.
Nice to Have
- Experience in real estate, tech, or a data-driven industry.
- Previous experience creating data reports or market trend analyses.
- Knowledge of SEO best practices for content.
Benefits
- Amazing and modern working environment. All things startup and flexible, as long as you bring results.
- Attractive compensation package with great potential.
- Private health insurance on our company's group program.
- Continuous Learning: access to a broad wealth of resources for professional and personal development.
- Various office perks.
- Opportunity to learn and develop in a leading tech startup which is growing very fast and currently manages the top 3 real estate verticals in Greece and multiple brands internationally: indomio.hr (Croatia), indomio.rs (Serbia), nepremicnine.net, indomio.si (Slovenia), indomio.ba (Bosnia and Herzegovina), indomio.me (Montenegro), indomio.bg (Bulgaria), indomio.com.mt (Malta), spitogatos.com.cy (Cyprus) and more to come soon.
- Opportunity to become part of a broader international team, consisting of some of the smartest people in the industry. Spitogatos was the first Greek VC-backed online business (in 2009 from Oxygen Capital), and since 2014 has become part of a big international player, Real Web SA, with presence in numerous countries in Europe (Italy, France, Spain, Netherlands, Greece, among others), in several industries / business models.
